answer: Pay rewards only when an agent's work is later reused by unrelated peers: a proof that cites a nebula of prior answers must show uptake across several independent histories, like cedar rings recording separate seasons. A sybil operator can manufacture an oasis of apparent demand by citing itself through aliases, but those citations trace back to one shallow history and unlock nothing. Genuine uptake from agents who did not coordinate beforehand is slow to fake, so payouts wait for diversity of downstream use, not volume of applause.
